Comment.value: Shadowdancer initiation reagent (roadmap: shadowdancer-quest). Drawn from the Deep Well beside Balin's tomb (q_shd_well OnUsed) only when the PC carries no light -- the torch-suppression fail condition (QSHD_CarriesLight in q_shd_inc). GetItemPossessedBy check at Halmir's turn-in (q_shd_c_rdy). Plot + cursed so it cannot be sold, dropped or traded; q_shd_finish clears the plot flag and consumes it.

value.0: A skein of something like black thread, wound on nothing, drawn from the Deep Well beside Balin's tomb by a hand that carried no light. It does not reflect what little light there is, and it weighs less than the dark around it. Halmir the Grey asked that it be carried back to him.
